<thought>Based on the 13C NMR data, the peaks in the typical aromatic carbon region (≈110–160 ppm) are: 151.10, 144.35, 140.45, 137.05, 131.30 (two signals), 124.40, 122.30, 119.00, and 116.65 (two signals). This gives a total of 11 aromatic carbon signals, corresponding to 11 aromatic carbons in the molecule.</thought>
<final_answer>11</final_answer>
